:::{#exr-bernoulli-hessian-sum}
#### Hessian of a binary sample

In the setting of @exr-bernoulli-score-sum,
assemble the [Hessian](#def-hessian) $\hess(\prob)$ of the whole [sample](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#def-sample)
from the Hessian contributions.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-bernoulli-hessian-sum}

$$
\begin{aligned}
\hess(\prob)
&= \sumin \hess_\iobs(\prob)
&& \text{(the derivative of a sum is the sum of the derivatives)}\\
&= \sumin \paren{-\frac{\outvar_\iobs}{\sqf{\prob}} - \frac{1 - \outvar_\iobs}{\sqf{1 - \prob}}}
&& \text{(Hessian contribution of a binary outcome)}\\
&= -\frac{1}{\sqf{\prob}} \sumin \outvar_\iobs - \frac{1}{\sqf{1 - \prob}} \sumin (1 - \outvar_\iobs)
&& \text{(split the sum; the denominators do not depend on $\iobs$)}\\
&= -\frac{n \outbar}{\sqf{\prob}} - \frac{1}{\sqf{1 - \prob}} \paren{n - n \outbar}
&& \text{($\textstyle\sumin \outvar_\iobs = n \outbar$ and $\textstyle\sumin 1 = n$)}\\
&= -\frac{n \outbar}{\sqf{\prob}} - \frac{n (1 - \outbar)}{\sqf{1 - \prob}}
&& \text{(factor out $n$)}\\
&= -n \paren{\frac{\outbar}{\sqf{\prob}} + \frac{1 - \outbar}{\sqf{1 - \prob}}}
&& \text{(factor out $-n$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
